title: Deep Learning to Automate Parameter Extraction and Model Fitting of Two-Dimensional Transistors
abstract: arXiv:2507.05134v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a deep learning approach to extract physical parameters (e.g., mobility, Schottky contact barrier height, defect profiles) of two-dimensional (2D) transistors from electrical measurements, enabling automated parameter extraction and technology computer-aided design (TCAD) fitting. To facilitate this task, we implement a simple data augmentation and pre-training approach by training a secondary neural network to approximate a physics-based device simulator. This method enables high-quality fits after training the neural network on electrical data generated from physics-based simulations of ~500 devices, a factor >40$\times$ fewer than other recent efforts. Consequently, fitting can be achieved by training on physically rigorous TCAD models, including complex geometry, self-consistent transport, and electrostatic effects, and is not limited to computationally inexpensive compact models. translated_title: 深度学习实现二维晶体管参数提取与模型拟合的自动化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种深度学习方法，可以从电学测量中提取二维晶体管的物理参数（例如迁移率、肖特基接触势垒高度、缺陷分布），实现自动化参数提取和工艺计算机辅助设计（TCAD）拟合。为了促进这一任务，我们实施了一种简单的数据增强和预训练方法，即训练一个辅助神经网络来逼近基于物理的器件仿真器。该方法使得在仅使用约500个器件的基于物理的仿真所生成的电学数据训练神经网络后，即可实现高质量拟合，所需数据量比其他近期工作减少了40倍以上。因此，拟合可以通过在物理上严谨的TCAD模型（包括复杂几何结构、自洽输运和静电效应）上训练来实现，而不局限于计算成本较低的紧凑模型。我们将我们的方法应用于逆向工程……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出一种结合数据增强与预训练的深度学习方法，仅需约500个器件的物理仿真数据即可自动提取二维晶体管的物理参数并完成严格的TCAD模型拟合，数据需求比以往方法减少40倍以上。
en_tdlr: A deep learning approach with simple data augmentation and pre-training enables automated extraction of physical parameters of 2D transistors and fitting to physically rigorous TCAD models using electrical data from only ~500 devices, over 40× less data than prior efforts.
